domain.text: watcher PR polling and per-PR conflict reconciliation

impressions.text: The worker delivered the requested per-PR error containment, durable refusal state, and once-per-resolution notice; the orchestrator confirmed that other PRs continue polling.
The worker reported targeted regression tests, typechecking, linting, formatting, build, and green CI; the review comment also confirmed CI was green on the current base.
A refusal now leaves automatic merging for manual follow-up, while reconciliation errors remain visible without escalating cards or weakening merge gates.
